findings.fix: Move them to an earlier file such as `EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean` or a new file in that directory.
findings.issue: Declarations defining external charged legs (`LegDirection`, `ChargedLeg`, `netCharge`, `chargedLine`) are broadly useful and do not depend on radiative corrections.

findings.evidence: They depend only on `DisKinematics` and `chargedLine`, completely independent of the `eikonalCurrent` defined in this file.
